Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect “normalization” rule to convert “Papal States” to “Rome” and even instructed preferring sources mentioning “Rome,” despite multiple reliable results indicating Girolamo Riario died in Forlì. This flawed methodology would misstate the death location, since Forlì (within the Papal States) is not Rome.
